newsitem.title: USA: Physician Corp. in $272 million takeover talks.
newsitem.headline: Physician Corp. in $272 million takeover talks.

text.p: Physician Corp of America said Monday that it is in negotiations that could result in the acquisition of the company for about $272 million.
It did not disclose the identity of the potential buyer but said a deal would be at a price of $7 per share in cash.
Physican Corp. provides comprehensive health care services through its Health Maintenance Organisations in Florida, Texas and Puerto Rico.
The sale, the company said, contemplates resolution of the company's insolvent property and casualty subsidiary.
In May, Physician Corp. said it had developed several viable proposals to resolve the insolvency of its workers' compensation subsidiary and expected to be able to reach a resolution before June 2.
At the time, Florida granted the company a 30-day extension on a scheduled court hearing relating to the workers' compensation subsidiary.
Physican Corp. said it had 38,837,657 shares outstanding as of March 31.
Physican Corp. stock was down 87.5 cents at $6.25 in morning trading on Nasdaq.
